name: Image
description: Georeferenced single image / GeoTIFF drawn on the 2D map via a GeoRaster layer, with optional single-band colormapping.

supportedData.label: GeoTIFF image
supportedData.description: A georeferenced GeoTIFF parsed client-side (georaster). RGB rasters render directly; single-band rasters are colormapped with a configurable ramp and min/max rescale (auto-derived via GDAL when unset).
supportedData.procurement: Any georeferenced GeoTIFF; a COG is recommended for large files.
